heading: INT. CALL CENTER IN DRAINED CRUISE-SHIP POOL - DAY

units.text: INT. CALL CENTER IN DRAINED CRUISE-SHIP POOL - DAY
The pool deck has been repurposed.
Desks rest on the tiled floor of the deep end, headsets dangling from the old diving board.
Painted fish swim up the walls.
The light is aquamarine and there is a persistent smell of chlorine and burnt coffee.
ARDEN PELLEGRINO, forties, regional manager, in a lanyard heavier than his tie, stands on the shallow-end steps with a whistle around his neck.
BASHIR QURESHI, thirties, team lead, sits at the nearest desk running a spreadsheet.
COLETTE MARCHAND, twenties, the newest agent, holds a script in both hands, mouthing it.
HOLDEN "HOLLY" ABERNATHY, fifties, the veteran, sits with his feet up and a headset around his neck, eyes closed.
All hands! Gather round the drain!
units.name: ARDEN

units.text: Arden, there's no one else here.
units.name: BASHIR

units.text: I know, Bashir. It's a habit.
units.name: ARDEN

units.text: Is this about the numbers?
units.name: COLETTE

units.text: It's always about the numbers.
units.name: HOLLY

units.text: Arden blows the whistle.
Nobody flinches.
A gull cries somewhere outside.
The ship's been sold.
units.name: ARDEN

units.text: What?
units.name: BASHIR

units.text: Finally.
units.name: HOLLY

units.text: Arden lowers the whistle.
His shoulders collapse slightly.
Bashir stops typing.
Colette folds her script into a small square and puts it in her pocket.
Holly opens one eye, scans the tiled floor, the painted fish, the rows of desks, the sagging diving board, and sits up.
Look. They say the call center moves to a container yard. Inland. A real one.
units.name: ARDEN

units.text: Do we get to keep our desks?
units.name: COLETTE

units.text: They're bolted to the pool.
units.name: ARDEN

units.text: Of course they are.
units.name: HOLLY

units.text: Arden sits on the top step.
He takes off the whistle, looks at it, and drops it into the empty deep end, where it clatters down the slope and comes to rest beside Holly's chair.
Holly picks it up.
He blows it once, softly.
A single, small, wheezing sound.
Well. That's what that was for.
units.name: HOLLY
